item.text: [{"task_id":"0520fde7","source_lines":["def run(params, grid, demos):","    separator = int(round(params['rule'][0]))","    foreground = int(round(params['rule'][1]))","    paint = int(round(params['rule'][2]))","    background = int(round(params['rule'][3]))","    direction = int(round(params['rule'][4]))","    if min(separator, foreground, paint, background) < 0 or max(separator, foreground, paint, background) > 9:","        return grid.copy()","    work = grid.T if direction != 0 else grid","    dividers = np.where(np.all(work == separator, axis=0))[0]","    if len(dividers) != 1:","        return grid.copy()","    split = int(dividers[0])","    left = work[:, :split]","    right = work[:, split + 1:]","    if left.shape != right.shape:","        return grid.copy()","    result = np.where(np.logical_and(left == foreground, right == foreground), paint, background)","    return result.T if direction != 0 else result"],"shapes":{"rule":[5]},"params":{"rule":[5,1,2,0,0]},"rationale":"Split at the solid gray column and mark corresponding cells red exactly when both panels contain blue.
